main.description: Returns current indexed follower counts for a mixed list of accounts and entities. No authentication is required. A DID subject counts distinct publishers of app.certified.graph.follow records naming that DID; an AT-URI subject counts distinct publishers of app.certified.graph.entityFollow records naming that URI. Counts match listActorFollowers and listEntityFollowers totalCount, and do not require the subject to be indexed.

subjects.description: Pass 1–100 account DIDs or full DID-authority entity AT-URIs, mixed freely, as repeated unbracketed subjects query parameters. The encoded GET request-target must not exceed 7,000 bytes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The subjects list is empty, has more than 100 entries, exceeds the request-target limit, or contains a value that is neither a valid DID nor a full DID-authority AT-URI; correct the list and retry.

errors.name: FollowerCountQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed follower count query failed; retry the request.

subject.description: Subject DID or AT-URI exactly as requested by the caller.

followerCount.description: Number of distinct indexed publisher DIDs with a current follow of this subject; zero when none are indexed.

counts.description: One entry for each requested subject, in request order. Repeated inputs produce repeated entries. Counts reflect current indexed state and may change between requests.
